# LeakSanitizer suppressions for known third-party library leaks.
# These are internal allocations in external dependencies that we cannot fix.

# Paho MQTT C library internal connection/session allocations
leak:libpaho-mqtt3as

# CWrapper connection contexts not freed when test teardown doesn't
# fully destroy CWrapper shared_ptrs (Paho async disconnect races)
leak:CWrapper::connectToHost
